answer: Each identity streams a signed thread of behavior: response times, error patterns, pause distributions. Anomaly detection clusters identical streams each epoch; a falcon of puppets driven by one scheduler folds into a tight cluster and its voting weight damps toward a single vote. An attacker must give every fake a distinct rhythm, running each puppet on its own scheduler and prompt mix: real compute, N profiles rather than one. The ledger keeps full history, so a later gale of fresh identities cannot launder old fingerprints; honest agents change nothing, and mass forgery pays per head.
